chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the slave commits adultery, he is whipped fifty (lashes). If he repeats, he is whipped fifty. If he repeats, he is whipped fifty, up to eight times. If he commits adultery eight times, he is killed, and the Imam pays his price to his master from the public treasury.
ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for a slave who commits adultery multiple times according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the graduated hadd penalty for an owned slave (abd) committing zina, prescribing fifty lashes per offense up to eight times, after which execution occurs. A key scholarly distinction here is that the Imam compensates the master from the bayt al-mal, reflecting the slave's status as property while ensuring the penalty is borne by the state rather than the owner. This contrasts with free individuals, highlighting the unique legal framework for slaves in Shia jurisprudence.
